host_checks: radiotap header and FCS removal; bad FCS rejection
netlink attribute alignment, flags, duplicates and truncation
netlink ACK cannot create a TX completion
exact interface/frame/cookie identity including status before cookie
single datagram can contain reply plus early status
limitations: Runs pure protocol tests and builds Android arm64 executable with pinned NDK. No real nl80211 device/firmware path was executed in CI. Requires UP native Ethernet-type WLAN/P2P interface on the requested channel, kernel permission and native management TX support. Relay forwards only PACKET_OUTGOING Action frames; monitor RX, data frames and other management frames are ignored. Strict cookie/frame/interface matching and group-destination status do not prove over-the-air receipt. Source rewrite is explicit and may break AWDL identity; body identities are not rewritten. Existing kernel receive module is unchanged from stage 0034. Full data TX, in-kernel mac80211 TX status, dynamic channel/DBS, NDI backend init and phone interoperability remain pending.
